This '''[[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Toydarian royal guard|royal guard]]''' was present on [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] inside [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko's]] palace around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] when Savage Opress [[Showdown at Toydaria|attacked]]. He informed the King about the intruder and was ordered, along with the rest of the guards, to stop him. However, Opress broke in, killing the two guards who were waiting for him. He then charged in and slayed the Toydarian Guard along with the others.
